page.overview:
Who is Wyald?

Wyald is shown as someone who is aware of the importance of going beyond the ordinary to have troops obey, be it by power, charisma or fear. He is a libertine, always following his motto "Excitement and Enjoyment". He possesses a gleeful lust for battle. Guts himself comments on his carelessness, that his technique is sloppy and he compensates by pure reflex. He often puts his men in serious danger for the sake of "fun", recklessly charging them through the Band of the Falcon's traps, killing a soldier beforehand after he protests and massacring them when they lose their morale. Wyald has absolutely no semblance of morality or empathy and takes a sadistic pleasure in his actions. He rapes and mutilates women, burns children alive, kills his own soldiers mostly for fun, and strips Casca and Griffith naked in front of their own men.

However, when the situation is dire, Wyald loses his usual cocky and playful attitude and becomes desperate, holding Griffith hostage in order to summon the God Hand to restore him. He later attempts to justify his actions to Nosferatu Zodd, who quickly kills him.

Wyald has a massive amount of strength, as he is capable of crushing one of his men's skulls with only two fingers, punches a falling boulder into pieces, stops Guts' sword with his teeth and a single hand, and rips a tree apart with his hands. He also has superhuman reflexes and speed, being able to parry/block all of Guts' attacks with ease using a simple log. Similarly, Wyald is able to capture Casca, who is known for being an agile fighter. He knows how to use psychological fear and charisma to the point he is able to intimidate his hardened criminal soldiers and make them obey.

Though he is not skilled, his apostle abilities made up for this to the point he could overwhelm more experienced and skilled opponents. While he is already immensely powerful and agile in his human form, his apostle form presents a massive boost in his basic abilities to the point where he can take out dozens of armed men with a tree trunk. His attacks also prove strong enough to break Guts' large sword.
